findings.title: enrichment_cache FOR ALL auth.uid() IS NOT NULL dumps and mutates VIN/property/business enrichment across tenants
findings.description: Policy enrichment_cache_all is FOR ALL with USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL) and no TO clause (PUBLIC). Table stores lookup_key, lookup_type, and data JSONB for property/business/VIN enrichment with a 90-day TTL. Not included in batch5a1/5a2/6b lockdowns. No later migration drops or scopes this policy. GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES TO authenticated applies.
findings.impact: Any authenticated principal (including a customer portal user) can read every enrichment cache entry project-wide (addresses, business profiles, VINs and related third-party payloads) and overwrite or delete cache rows.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any user JWT (portal signup is enough).
2. GET /rest/v1/enrichment_cache?select=id,lookup_key,lookup_type,data,source,fetched_at
3. RLS FOR ALL allows every row because auth.uid() is not null.
4. Optional: PATCH/DELETE rows to poison or erase enrichment results.
findings.remediation: DROP enrichment_cache_all. Scope SELECT/writes to is_staff() plus workspace membership, or restrict all access to service_role only (edge enrichment writers).
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: field_output_history SELECT USING(TRUE) dumps extracted insurance field values to every authenticated user
findings.description: field_history_select is FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (TRUE). Columns include raw_value, normalized_value, field_name, evidence_ids, and extraction_id. Sibling of already-reported llm_invocations/llm_artifacts but a distinct table holding the actual extracted field values. No later migration drops or scopes this SELECT. INSERT is also open to any logged-in user (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL).
findings.impact: Cross-tenant dump of OCR/LLM-extracted insurance fields (named insured, VINs, limits, FEIN-bearing text, driver data) to any portal or staff user.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. GET /rest/v1/field_output_history?select=id,extraction_id,field_name,raw_value,normalized_value,confidence_raw,evidence_ids,is_current
3. All rows return via USING(TRUE).
findings.remediation: Replace SELECT with staff plus workspace scope via document_extractions → account join. Restrict INSERT to service_role.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: extraction_review_queue SELECT USING(TRUE) plus any-auth UPDATE exposes and mutates full review queue_data JSON
findings.description: review_queue_select is TO authenticated USING (TRUE). queue_data JSONB holds the full ReviewQueue (questions, candidate values, conflicts). review_queue_update is USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL) with no staff/workspace bind. Sibling review_responses_select is also USING (TRUE) for original_value/corrected_value. Never locked by batch5a2 (table not in the rewrite list) or later tenancy hardening.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can read every extraction review queue (insurance field candidates and conflicts) across tenants and overwrite status/assignment/queue_data.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. GET /rest/v1/extraction_review_queue?select=id,extraction_id,queue_data,status,required_missing
3. GET /rest/v1/review_responses?select=field_name,original_value,corrected_value
4. Optional: PATCH extraction_review_queue to alter status or queue_data.
findings.remediation: DROP the USING(TRUE)/auth.uid()-only policies. Scope SELECT/UPDATE to is_staff() and workspace membership via the parent extraction account.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: document_evidence_items Staff policies are only auth.uid() IS NOT NULL; any login dumps OCR evidence snippets
findings.description: Policies named Staff can view/insert evidence items use USING/WITH CHECK (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL) with no is_staff or workspace predicate. GRANT SELECT, INSERT TO authenticated. get_evidence_item is SECURITY DEFINER with no auth guard and GRANT EXECUTE TO authenticated, so even a future table lockdown would still be bypassable via RPC.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can list OCR evidence snippets (snippet_text, bbox, labels) for every extraction across tenants.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. GET /rest/v1/document_evidence_items?select=extraction_id,evidence_id,page_index,snippet_text,label,confidence
3. Or POST /rest/v1/rpc/get_evidence_item with extraction_id and evidence_id.
findings.remediation: Replace Staff policies with is_staff() and workspace scope via extraction→account. Gate get_evidence_item the same way, or convert to SECURITY INVOKER after fixing table RLS.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: coi_build_line SECURITY DEFINER has no auth guard and returns full COI line JSON for any policy_id
findings.description: coi_build_line is SECURITY DEFINER, loads policies by caller-supplied p_policy_id, and returns limits, AI rows, and provenanced cells. Unlike get_master_coi / save_master_coi_fields in the same migration (which call is_staff()), coi_build_line has no is_staff or is_agency_member check. GRANT EXECUTE TO authenticated.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user who obtains a policy UUID can exfiltrate commercial COI line details (limits, named insured cells, additional insureds) across tenants. Policy UUIDs are enumerable via already-reported listing holes.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. Obtain a policies.id (UI leak or prior listing hole).
3. POST /rest/v1/rpc/coi_build_line with {"p_policy_id":"<uuid>","p_line":"gl"} (also auto/umbrella/wc/property).
4. DEFINER returns the assembled COI line JSON.
findings.remediation: Add is_staff() and is_agency_member on the policy account workspace before selecting, matching get_master_coi. Or revoke EXECUTE from authenticated and keep as an internal helper only.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: sync_renewals_from_policies SECURITY DEFINER creates renewals across all tenants with no auth guard
findings.description: Function is SECURITY DEFINER, loops all upcoming policies, and INSERTs renewals with no is_staff check. GRANT EXECUTE TO authenticated. Distinct from sync_policies_to_renewals which was staff-gated in 20260702090000. No later CREATE OR REPLACE adds a guard.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can mass-create renewal rows for every agency book, corrupting renewal pipelines and ops dashboards.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. POST /rest/v1/rpc/sync_renewals_from_policies with {"p_days_ahead":365}.
3. DEFINER inserts renewals for matching policies project-wide.
findings.remediation: Require service_role or is_staff() plus workspace filter. Prefer retiring this RPC in favor of the hardened sync_policies_to_renewals path.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: portal_branding FOR ALL auth.uid() IS NOT NULL lets any login overwrite agency portal branding
findings.description: authenticated_manage_portal_branding grants FOR ALL with only auth.uid() IS NOT NULL. Columns include agency_name, logo_url, primary_color, contact_phone, contact_email, footer_text, and account_id. GRANT ALL TO authenticated. No later migration scopes this table.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can replace another agency's portal branding (logo, contact channels, colors), enabling phishing and trust abuse on document-collection / portal surfaces.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. GET /rest/v1/portal_branding?select=*
3. PATCH a victim row setting logo_url and contact_email to attacker-controlled values.
4. Clients hitting the branded portal see attacker branding.
findings.remediation: Scope FOR ALL to is_staff() and is_agency_member on the branding account workspace. Restrict public reads to safe columns if needed.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: llm_prompt_templates UPDATE via auth.uid() IS NOT NULL lets any login poison extraction prompts
findings.description: templates_update is TO authenticated USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL). templates_select is USING (TRUE). Prompt bodies drive document extraction LLM calls. Distinct from already-reported llm_invocations/llm_artifacts SELECT dumps: this is integrity compromise of the template store itself. No later lockdown.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can overwrite system/user prompt templates used for OCR extraction, causing incorrect underwriting data writes or prompt-injection into the extraction pipeline.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. GET /rest/v1/llm_prompt_templates?select=id,template_name,version,is_active
3. PATCH a default template's prompt body.
4. Subsequent extractions use the poisoned template.
findings.remediation: Restrict SELECT to is_staff(); restrict INSERT/UPDATE to service_role or admin-only. Version templates immutably.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: get_collection_status_summary SECURITY DEFINER has no auth guard and returns collection progress for any workspace_id
findings.description: SECURITY DEFINER RPC takes arbitrary p_workspace_id and aggregates collection_requirements statuses with no is_staff, ownership, or token check. GRANT EXECUTE TO authenticated. Distinct from already-reported get_portal_packet_data (anon packet dump).
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can probe collection packet UUIDs for completion/rejection progress and required-document counts across tenants.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. Obtain a collection workspace UUID (URL leak or generate_collection_token path).
3. POST /rest/v1/rpc/get_collection_status_summary with p_workspace_id.
4. Receive progress JSON without proving packet ownership.
findings.remediation: Require is_staff() and ownership of the collection workspace, or a validated portal token. Revoke broad authenticated EXECUTE if only staff UI needs it.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: reprocessing_queue FOR ALL USING(true) lets any authenticated user read and rewrite extraction reprocessing jobs
findings.description: authenticated_access on reprocessing_queue is FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (true). Later prompt-versioning migration added additional SELECT TRUE / INSERT/UPDATE auth.uid() policies that OR with this ALL policy. Table not in batch5a2. Holds extraction_id and reprocessing settings.
findings.impact: Portal users can list every reprocessing job and force/cancel/repioritize reprocessing across tenants (integrity and processing-cost abuse).
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. GET /rest/v1/reprocessing_queue?select=*
3. PATCH status/priority or INSERT forged jobs.
findings.remediation: DROP authenticated_access and the sibling open policies. Scope to service_role writers and staff SELECT with workspace bind.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.
